locations.note: Street racing and the opening LIVE event run through a condensed recreation of New York.
Miami's streets and waterfront host car and powerboat events in the motorsport career.
San Francisco's hills and bay form a recognizable setting for driving and other motorsport events.
The condensed open-world United States includes a recognizable Los Angeles.
The map includes the Las Vegas Strip and surrounding desert.
The game recreates a recognizable Chicago skyline and waterfront.
Detroit is one of the recognizable city regions in the open world.
